_comment: Per-file guard for fields whose loss has already caused a production incident. The module-wide parity check cannot see these: it compares a flat set of field names, so a field removed from one struct still looks present if any other struct decodes the same name (deployedProductCount is decoded in both sn_deployment_service.go and sn_project_stats_service.go). This file pins the decode site itself. Regenerate deliberately, never to make a red build green.
